subject.title: [BUG] drive list/info ignore pagination; info falsely reports File not found past page 1

question: Should `feishu_drive` `info` grow an explicit folder-scoped lookup contract, such as optional `folder_token` with bounded cursor walking, or remain root-only with users expected to use `list` for folder browsing?
rationale: Current main intentionally avoids forwarding root cursors because Feishu bot credentials have no browsable root, so the remaining fix is not only a mechanical pagination loop.

options.title: Add folder-scoped info lookup
options.body: Expose and forward a concrete `folder_token` for `info`, paginate within that folder only, and require regression plus SDK-boundary or live proof.

options.title: Keep info root-only
options.body: Document root-only `info` behavior and narrow or close the issue after confirming that folder lookup should remain a `list` workflow.

recommendation.title: Add folder-scoped info lookup
recommendation.body: Expose and forward a concrete `folder_token` for `info`, paginate within that folder only, and require regression plus SDK-boundary or live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the merged list-half fix and supplied the latest maintainer context about the remaining folder-aware info contract.
